description_en: Registers or updates the default webhook callback URL
description_zh: 用于注册&更新默认webhook 回调地址
kebab_example: aliyun agentretailvision register-webhook --callback-url https://example.com/callback --callback-secret your_secret_key --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegisterWebhook

parameters.help_en: The default callback URL. A public HTTPS URL is required

parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en: The key used for callback signature verification
